1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

3136|b873f90f.name: Clarise Gnarltree
3136|b873f90f.text: Now I'm the one who feels rough around the edges, I honestly don't think there's anything left I can teach you. But you know who can? Bengus Deepforge in Ironforge, now there's a dwarf that knows his steel. Go look him up in The Great Forge of Ironforge, see if he's up to having a new trainee under him.

4456|0be64368.name: Fiora Longears
4456|0be64368.text: No, Longears isn't my real name.  And I'm not going to tell you what it is, so don't ask.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

1250-accept.name: Tapoke "Slim" Jahn
1250-accept.text:
The Defias didn't pay me well enough to die for their cause. They took the king. Yeah, the king of Stormwind, not some lowly diplomat. He was on his way to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore--it was a big deal apparently, and a big secret. But it's not just the Defias that are involved. They're working with someone. I think they knew this was bigger than them.

My part was just to get their man on board the king's ship while it was moored. The guy's name was Hendel. That's all I know. I swear!
1250-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1324-complete.name: Archmage Tervosh
1324-complete.text:
I assure you, we're all quite upset about current events, but allow us to take him back to Theramore for some questioning, and we'll see about finding the King.

I'm sure my lady Proudmoore would like to thank you for your help. Speak to her when you have a moment.
1324-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

134-progress.name: Abercrombie
134-progress.text: Do you have my crate?  If so, then please...give it to me quickly!
134-progress.title: Ogre Thieves

1447-progress.name: Dashel Stonefist
1447-progress.text: I didn't mean anything by the comment 'bout you being a stupid $c. We're friends, right? No hard feelings?
1447-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

160-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
160-progress.text:
Abercrombie...?  I don't know a person of that name.  You say you have a letter for me from this Abercrombie fellow?

Well let's have it then...
160-progress.title: Note to the Mayor

251-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
251-progress.text: A note from Abercrombie the hermit, eh?  I don't know him, though if he lives out at the graveyard then I do know his brains have rotted out!
251-progress.title: Translate Abercrombie's Note

252-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
252-progress.text: Ah, is the note translated?  Please, let me see it...
252-progress.title: Translation to Ello

253-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
253-progress.text: Have you yet found Eliza's grave?  Do you have the Embalmer's heart?
253-progress.title: Bride of the Embalmer
